name: Akazukin-chan
source:
A parody work to the Little Red Riding Hood.
You are given a task by mother to visit grandmother. There are multiple traps awaiting on this way...

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一部恶搞《小红帽》的作品。
母亲交给你一项任务，要你前去探望外婆。然而通往外婆家的路上，正有重重陷阱等待着你……

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
